summary: Approved as readable, behavior-validated unmatched C++ with zero matching-source byte credit.
reason: Source control flow, ECX/EDX ABI, layouts, pointer returns and read-only behavior agree with the reference. Independently ran all 15,488 mapped differential cases and verified all five linked reference routines against immutable Game.exe bytes. Tests compare result pointers, MXCSR and storage bytes across meaningful edge cases. Native compilation records cover the actual implementation. External dependencies and platform/testing limits are disclosed; sampled validation does not establish all-input equivalence.
